items.title: German judge proposes dropping Movie2k case if operator hands over $2.56 billion in bitcoin
items.summary: Prosecutors estimate the defendant still holds 56,000 BTC, meaning the proposed deal would leave him with roughly $1 billion.

items.title: Hong Kong wants banks to use AI to catch crypto crime before money disappears
items.summary: As Hong Kong pushes banks to use AI to combat crypto crime, experts say the technology must detect suspicious transfers without putting customer funds at risk.

items.title: Bitcoin miner MARA raises $185 million in debt after selling $1 billion BTC to repay loans
items.summary: The bitcoin miner is taking on borrowing tied to an Ohio power plant as it shifts more of its business toward AI infrastructure.

items.title: Bullish beats revenue estimates as institutional services offset sluggish spot crypto volumes
items.summary: Bullish’s institutional focus may have shielded the company from the decline in activity experienced by rivals catering to retail traders and offers some insight to its revenue beat.

items.title: Circle turns to DBS as banks build rival digital payment systems across Asia
items.summary: The Singapore bank will let institutional clients buy and redeem USDC directly as banks across Asia develop their own blockchain payment systems.

items.title: Bitcoin drops as Nvidia earnings report drives stock index futures higher
items.summary: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.1% since midnight UTC at around $64,100, failing to keep pace with rising stock index futures after Nvidia beat earnings.

items.title: Bitcoin outpaces gold even as both assets tumble ahead of a likely Fed rate hike
items.summary: Bitcoin held near $64,000 as gold fell 2%, lifting the ratio between the two above its 200-day moving average and extending a series of higher lows since March.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&amp;P over USDT reserve risks
items.summary: S&amp;P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

items.title: Ledger warns Berlin customers as hardware wallet tampering investigation expands
items.summary: Ledger advised customers who purchased devices in Berlin since January 2026 to contact support as it investigates suspected hardware implants in Germany and Dubai.

items.title: Bain Capital Crypto leads $110M Variational round at $1.5B valuation
items.summary: Variational raised $110 million at a $1.5 billion valuation to expand Omni’s derivatives markets and increase trading limits.

items.title: Binance says it obtained $6.5B worldwide freezing order after hack
items.summary: The court orders allow legal notices to be served via blockchain and provide for a continuously updated list of 26,000 wallet addresses linked to stolen assets, Binance’s lawyers said.

items.title: MARA prices $185M debt offering after $1.1B Bitcoin sale
items.summary: The Bitcoin miner is taking on new debt to finance its AI infrastructure expansion, with the Long Ridge acquisition adding nearly $69 million in annual interest costs.

items.title: $25M Ethereum MEV acquittal tests criminal enforcement limits
items.summary: BlackRock’s staked Ether ETF earns a cut of what traders pay for priority on Ethereum, the acquittal left the legal risk to that income unresolved.

items.title: Polymarket US takes rapid-fire crypto trading format to oil, natural gas
items.summary: Polymarket US said it attracted more than 300,000 traders to its short-duration crypto markets in six weeks and is now expanding the format to energy commodities.

items.title: Bitcoin, stocks wobble as Fed’s Waller talks of ‘shock’ 50-point rate hike
items.summary: Bitcoin price action dropped below $63,000 after fresh hawkish comments from the Fed as Nvidia earnings optimism faded.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 6: FE Covenants — Enforcing covenants through cryptographically restricted signing keys
items.summary: FE covenants encode spending constraints into the signing key, so only transactions that satisfy a predefined condition can be signed.

items.title: Ledger Confirms Tampered Bitcoin Wallets in Berlin as Spy Implant Probe Spreads Beyond Asia
items.summary: Ledger says its hardware implant investigation has confirmed tampered devices in Berlin and is examining two suspected units in Dubai, as the incident spreads beyond Southeast Asia.

items.title: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok Helped Plan Terror Attacks in Government Tests
items.summary: Federal investigators bypassed safeguards on four popular chatbots, producing viable attack plans within hours.

items.title: Palmer Luckey Says He’s Building an Offshore Haven for Industry—And 'Illegal' Medicine
items.summary: The Oculus founder says his decade-old SLAB project aims to escape state restrictions on manufacturing and medical treatment.

items.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
items.summary: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.

items.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
items.summary: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.

items.title: Bitcoin Tanks Ahead of Anthropic’s IPO. Should We Really Blame AI?
items.summary: Bitcoin slid toward $63,000 as Anthropic prepared its blockbuster debut. Analysts dispute whether the IPO is draining crypto liquidity, pointing instead to ETF outflows, forced selling and rising interest rates.

items.title: Bitcoin Miners Are Selling Their Stacks to Fund the AI Boom
items.summary: MARA sold 13,597 BTC after September and Riot sold 20,264 BTC through September to fund debt repayment and AI data center buildouts, as Glassnode flagged the pair as the main sellers among Bitcoin treasury firms.

items.title: Fed's Waller Calls for 50-Basis-Point Rate Hike, Says Tokenized Finance Still Needs Traditional Banks

items.title: Lucky Trader Banks 66,000% Profit on GTA 6 Meme Coin Ticker Confusion
items.summary: The trader turned $300 into over $200,000 as early footage of GTA 6 sent degens flocking between different token tickers.

items.title: 'It Speaks in Tongues That Only 6.2 Astra Understands': Why Early Testers Hate OpenAI’s New Model
items.summary: OpenAI's flagship AI model is dazzling developers with 3D creations, but early testers say it stalls during long projects, gives baffling explanations, and hides failures.
